c1.evidence: Cred.ai is a real operating fintech; its Unicorn Card (issued by WSFS Bank) is live — cred.ai/signup-today loaded live and 2026 reviews confirm an active product.

c2.evidence: No concrete official cash mechanism exists in Cred.ai's offering: the product has no rewards, no cashback, and no signup bonus — by design.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee: the Unicorn Card charges no fees and no interest under the Cred.ai Guaranty.

c4.evidence: No concrete official cash payout exists to anchor any amount to: independent reviews state 'Does Cred AI offer rewards or cashback? No' and Cred.ai's own pitch is fee-free credit building only.

s1.note: Unicorn Card: no hard credit pull to apply; requires a linked bank account (via Plaid) or the Cred.ai deposit account; credit limit $500-$1,500 set from deposits; autopay pays the balance monthly.

s2.note: No fees, no interest, no payments under the Cred.ai Guaranty (with autopay on); deposits FDIC-insured up to $250,000 via WSFS Bank.

s3.note: No bonus payout timing exists because no bonus exists.

s4.note: The catalog claim ('check for signup bonus') is concrete but cannot be anchored to any official Cred.ai terms — there is no signup bonus to find.

s5.note: https://cred.ai/signup-today — Cred.ai's official page, loaded live; pitch is 'never pay fees or interest, never overspend, build credit automatically' — no cash mechanism.

s6.note: No steps given: no concrete official cash bonus exists (reject).

eligibility: Anyone can apply for the Unicorn Card (no hard credit pull), but applying earns you no cash — the product is a fee-free credit-builder only.
biggest_catch: Cred.ai is alive but has no cash mechanism at all — no signup bonus, no rewards, no cashback by design; it only builds your credit history, which puts no money in your pocket.
catches: No signup bonus exists on cred.ai — the product offers no welcome bonus.
'Does Cred AI offer rewards or cashback? No' — independent 2026 review; Cred.ai deliberately omits rewards programs ('traditional cashback is a karma trap' per co-founder Dylan Brown).
The credit limit ($500-$1,500, set from your own deposits) is borrowing power, not money — borrowing is not income.
Credit-building only helps indirectly over time (better credit profile); it is not a money-making route.
If autopay is off and the balance is not paid, purchase APR 16.01% and cash-advance APR 24.99% apply.
